description: This file defines the NewsArticle class used to model news articles within the Flutter project. It includes properties for headline, image, description, URL, source, publication time, and content. The class provides methods to convert from and to database maps, as well as parsing from JSON from the NewsAPI.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a news article with fields for headline, image, description, URL, source, time, and content. Provides methods for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: toDbMap
methods.description: Converts a NewsArticle instance to a Map<String, Object?> suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromDbMap
methods.description: Creates a NewsArticle instance from a database map.

methods.name: fromNewsApiJson
methods.description: Constructs a NewsArticle object from a JSON map obtained from the NewsAPI.
